approvals.empty: Nothing is waiting for your approval.
approvals.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this approval request? The document returns to not submitted.

sequences.title: Number sequences
sequences.hint: Document numbers follow prefix – company code – period – sequence. Changes apply only to numbers issued afterwards.
sequences.prefixHint: Capital letters and digits only, up to 10 characters.

rates.title: Exchange rates

audit.title: Audit log

deactivate.nothing: The employee has nothing to hand over.
deactivate.doneRemoved: Removed from this company and handed over.

mfaReset.title: Reset two-factor authentication
mfaReset.text: {name}'s authenticator key and backup codes will be deleted and every session ends. The employee sets it up again at next sign-in. This action is logged.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.hint: App IDs and provider keys for Google, Microsoft, Zalo sign-in and messaging through eSMS.vn. Secrets are encrypted and only the last 4 characters are shown; leave a secret blank to keep the stored one. Changes apply immediately.

integrations.testPhoneHint: Uses the registered OTP template (Zalo first, then SMS); message fees apply.
integrations.testSent: Test message sent. Check the phone and the delivery log below.
integrations.testFailed: Test message failed. See the error in the delivery log below.

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.noTemplate: The company has no proposal templates yet. Contact your company administrator.
proposals.submitText: After submission the proposal gets a number and can no longer be edited. Submit it?
proposals.withdrawText: Withdraw this proposal before anyone approves it?
proposals.deleteText: Delete this draft and its attachments?
proposals.attachHint: PDF, JPG, PNG, XLSX, DOCX; up to 10 files, 10 MB each.
proposals.noPolicy: This proposal type has no approval policy yet, so it cannot be submitted.

templates.title: Proposal templates
templates.hint: Each template is a document type that needs approval: set its approval policy under Approval policies and its numbering under Number sequences. Editing a template does not change existing proposals.
templates.none: The company has no proposal templates.
templates.codeHint: Capital letters and digits, up to 10 characters; used as the number prefix.
templates.name: Template name
templates.label: Label
templates.columns: Table columns (one per line: key|label|type text, number or money; the money column keyed amount is the line total)

categories.title: Categories and units
categories.hint: Shared by every company in the group. Only group administrators add or edit. The category code is the prefix of product codes.
categories.pick: Select a category to see details.
categories.codeHint: 2 to 6 capital letters or digits; locked once products exist.
categories.trackingHint: Default for new products; can be changed per product.
categories.deactivateText: Deactivate this category? New products cannot use it; existing products are unchanged.
categories.requiresQualityCheckLabel: Requires quality check on purchase receipt (goods stay out of stock until checked)

products.title: Products
products.codeHint: Leave blank to generate from the category code.
products.name: Product name
products.baseUnitHint: Stock unit; locked once transactions exist.
products.deactivateText: Discontinue this product? It cannot be chosen on new documents.
products.perBaseUnit: Per base unit; used to allocate import costs.
products.conversionsHint: For example: 1 carton = 24 {unit}. Up to 5 units.
products.optionsHint: Up to 3 options (for example Colour, Size); each variant is one SKU. A product without options has one SKU.
products.imageHint: JPG, PNG, WEBP; up to 10 images, 5 MB each.
products.kindHint: Services are not stocked and do not track lots or serial numbers.

productImport.title: Import products from Excel
productImport.hint: Each row is one variant. Rows with the same product code (or the same name when the code is blank) form one product; general details come from its first row. Write options like "Colour: Black" and conversions like "THUNG=24; HOP=6". Tracking: blank (from category), "Lô", "Serial", "Không". VAT: 0, 5, 8, 10, KCT, KKKNT.
productImport.fileHint: .xlsx file, up to 2,000 rows, 5 MB. Products with errors are skipped; the others are imported.
productImport.result: Imported {products} products, {variants} variants; {failed} rows with errors.
productImport.more: {count} more rows with errors in the error file.

productLinks.title: Links to other companies
productLinks.hint: Matching products in other subsidiaries, used for intercompany trading. Factor: base units on the other side per one base unit here.
productLinks.none: Not linked to any company yet.
productLinks.noSuggestions: No unlinked products with the same barcode.
productLinks.copied: Copied to {company} and linked each variant.
productLinks.copyHint: Requires product management permission in the target company too.

channels.title: Sales channels, customer groups
channels.defaultsHint: Default channels: Wholesale, Retail, VComm marketplace, Internal. Existing channels are not added again.
channels.codeHint: Uppercase letters, digits, underscores; cannot be changed later.
channels.name: Name

priceLists.title: Price lists
priceLists.hint: When selling, the system picks the price list matching both channel and customer group, then customer group only, then channel only, and finally the general price list.
priceLists.name: Name
priceLists.channelHint: Channel, customer group and currency cannot be changed after creation.
priceLists.noPrices: This price list has no prices. Create a price change to set prices.
priceLists.noProductPrices: This product has no prices in this price list.
priceLists.productPricesMore: Showing the first {count} rows; see all on the Price lists screen.

priceChanges.title: Price change
priceChanges.hint: Prices change only through price changes. With an approval policy, prices change after approval; without one, prices change on submission.
priceChanges.noLines: No items yet. Search for a product or import from Excel.
priceChanges.searchProduct: Search for a product to add
priceChanges.submitText: After submission the price change gets a number and can no longer be edited. Submit?
priceChanges.withdrawText: Withdraw before anyone approves? The status becomes Withdrawn and prices do not change.
priceChanges.appliedNow: The company has no approval policy for price changes, so the prices were applied.

warehouses.title: Warehouses and locations
warehouses.hint: A warehouse belongs to a branch. Staff with inventory rights at that branch handle all goods in it, including goods of other owner companies; staff of an owner company only see their own stock.
warehouses.codeHint: Uppercase letters, digits, hyphens; cannot be changed later.
warehouses.name: Warehouse name
warehouses.otherOwners: Other companies allowed to store goods
warehouses.otherOwnersHint: The owning company can always store goods. A company can be removed only when it has no stock left here.
warehouses.usesLocationsHint: Can be changed only when the warehouse has no stock.
warehouses.addLocationsHint: One location per line: code, then an optional name. Example: A-01-01 Rack A level 1.
warehouses.reservationHoursHint: Reserved goods are released when an order is not shipped in time. Default 72 hours.

stockCard.title: Stock card
stockCard.choose: Choose an item from the Stock screen.

documents.title: Stock documents
documents.ownerHint: Numbered, approved and accounted for by the owner company.
documents.chooseType: Choose a document type from the list.
documents.scan: Scan a barcode or type a SKU or name, then press Enter
documents.itemNotFound: No item of the owner company was found.
documents.adjustmentHint: Positive quantities increase stock, negative ones decrease it (for example -5).
documents.serialsHint: One serial per line; the count must equal the base-unit quantity.
documents.submitText: After submission the document gets a number, decreased goods are reserved and it can no longer be edited. Without an approval policy it is posted immediately.
documents.withdrawText: Withdraw before anyone approves? Reserved goods are released.
documents.postedNow: The owner company has no approval policy for this type, so the document was posted.
documents.approvedNow: The owner company has no approval policy for transfers, so the transfer was approved; the source warehouse confirms shipping.
documents.receiveHint: Enter the received quantity in the base unit. Shortages or surpluses create a discrepancy report.
documents.qualityCheckHint: Enter the rejected quantity per line; accepted goods are posted to stock, rejected goods are recorded with a reason.
documents.qualityChecked: Quality check recorded; accepted goods are in stock.
documents.noOpenOrders: No approved purchase orders to receive into your warehouses.
documents.chooseReceipt: Choose a purchase receipt to return goods.
documents.returnHint: Returned goods are issued at the original receipt price.
documents.purchaseReceiveHint: Enter the received quantity for lines that arrived; leave others blank.
documents.noOpenSalesOrders: No confirmed sales orders to deliver from your warehouses.
documents.issueHint: Enter the quantity delivered this time; leave other lines blank.
documents.chooseIssue: Choose a delivery to receive a return.
documents.salesReturnHint: Returned goods are received at the original delivery cost.
documents.receiveInternalHint: Enter the quantity actually received in base units; for serial items tick the serials received. If short, give a reason; the selling company gets a discrepancy record to handle.

stocktakes.title: Stocktake
stocktakes.hint: Starting a stocktake locks the items in scope; other documents cannot be posted on them until it finishes. Finishing creates an adjustment for the differences.
stocktakes.addItem: Add product (scan or type a SKU, then press Enter)
stocktakes.scan: Scan barcodes to count (each scan adds 1)
stocktakes.extraItems: Items found but not on the books
stocktakes.startText: Book quantities are captured and items in scope are locked until the stocktake finishes. Start?
stocktakes.finishText: Every line must be counted. Differences create an adjustment for approval; compensation defaults to the shortage value. Finish?
stocktakes.cancelText: Cancel this stocktake and unlock the items?

reservations.title: Reservations and safety stock
reservations.itemHint: Scan a barcode or type a SKU, then press Enter

partners.title: Partners
partners.hint: Partners are shared across the group; customer and supplier profiles belong to each company.
partners.name: Name
partners.taxCodeHint: 10 digits, or 10 digits plus "-" and a 3-digit branch number.
partners.citizenIdHint: 12 digits. If the customer does not provide one, do not create a partner; sales use a buyer without invoice.
partners.internalHint: Internal partners take their details from the subsidiary; edit them on the Companies screen.
partners.deactivateConfirm: Stop trading with {name}? The partner cannot be chosen on new documents; existing data is kept.
partners.identityLogged: Every full view is recorded in the audit log.
partners.noProfile: The selected company does not trade with this partner yet.
partners.creditLimitHint: In the company currency. Leave blank for no limit.
partners.selfProfile: This is the selected company; it cannot have a partner profile.

purchasing.itemSearchHint: Barcode, SKU or name, then press Enter

supplierPrices.title: Supplier prices
supplierPrices.hint: Prices exclude VAT and use the company currency. Purchase orders suggest the price valid on the order date with the largest minimum quantity not above the ordered quantity.

supplierPrices.minQuantityHint: The price applies from this quantity upward. 0: any quantity.
supplierPrices.validToHint: Leave blank for no end date.

orders.baseUnitHint: Received and still receivable use the base unit; still receivable includes the over-receipt tolerance.
orders.closeHint: The unreceived remainder is cancelled; the warehouse can no longer receive against this order.
orders.reapproveHint: Approved order: increasing the total or changing the supplier sends the order for approval again.
orders.toleranceHint: The warehouse may receive up to this percentage above the ordered quantity. Default 0.
orders.counterpartFromSales: Created from the sales order of {company}: {number}
orders.counterpartPendingHint: The selling company sold to this company. Choose the receiving warehouse and confirm (the order goes through approval as usual), or reject with a reason.
orders.internalPriceHint: Internal supplier: price from the selling company's Internal channel price list, not editable.

salesOrders.title: Sales orders
salesOrders.customerHint: Leave blank for a buyer who does not take an invoice.
salesOrders.noPrice: No price in the price lists for this channel and customer group.

salesOrders.baseUnitHint: Delivered quantities use the base unit.

salesOrders.counterpartFromPurchase: Created from the purchase order of {company}: {number}

salesOrders.promotionHint: Active promotions apply when saved (line, order discounts, gifts); the estimate excludes promotions.
salesOrders.giftShortage: {name}: {sets} gift sets missing because the warehouse lacks gift stock.
salesOrders.allowManualGoodsOrders: Allow manual sales orders with goods
salesOrders.allowManualGoodsOrdersHint: Off by default: manual sales orders contain services only; goods are sold through the VComm marketplace.

internalDiscrepancies.title: Internal delivery discrepancies
internalDiscrepancies.hint: The buying company received less than shipped. Return to stock: create and post a return into the issuing warehouse at the delivery cost. Write off: only close the record; accounting is handled with Finance.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.name: Name
promotions.channelsHint: None selected: every channel except Internal.
promotions.customerGroupsHint: None selected: every customer, including walk-in buyers.

ledger.postError: Approved but could not be posted: {reason} Edit and submit again.

collections.warnings: {count} lines differ from the order's open amount: shortfall stays owed, excess becomes customer advance.

consolidation.noProfitLines: No internal purchases in the period.

visits.title: Customer visits
visits.hint: Visits recorded in the sales app across the company.

candidates.consentEvidenceHint: Signed consent, or a screenshot of the candidate's consenting email or message (Decree 356/2025/ND-CP Article 6).
candidates.poolConsentHint: Only when the candidate agrees to be kept for other postings.
candidates.rejectedRetentionDays: Days kept after not hiring (0 to 90)
candidates.poolRetentionMonths: Months kept in talent pool (1 to 24)
candidates.retentionLaw: Personal Data Protection Law 91/2025/QH15 Article 25(1)(c): applicant data must be erased when not hired unless otherwise agreed. Changing the periods recalculates every candidate's erasure date.
candidates.erasedNotice: The candidate's data was erased at {date}.
candidates.endHint: An ended application cannot be reopened. Without active applications the data is erased after the retention period unless the candidate joined the talent pool.
candidates.sendRejection: Email the result to the candidate
candidates.poolWithdrawn: Pool consent withdrawn; erasure date recalculated.
candidates.erasureWarning: Erases immediately and cannot be undone: active applications end as "withdrew", open offers and scheduled interviews are cancelled, files and identifying data are erased. Legal deadline: 20 days (Decree 356/2025/ND-CP Article 5).

recruitmentEmails.invitationBody:
Dear {name},

{company} would like to invite you to the {round} for the {title} position.
Time: {time} ({duration} minutes)
{place}

The attached calendar file lets you add the interview to your calendar.

{message}If you need to reschedule, please reply to {email}.

Best regards,
{company}
recruitmentEmails.updateBody:
Dear {name},

The {round} for the {title} position has changed.
New time: {time} ({duration} minutes)
{place}

{message}If you have questions, please contact {email}.

Best regards,
{company}
recruitmentEmails.cancellationBody:
Dear {name},

{company} has cancelled the {round} for the {title} position planned at {time}.

{message}If you have questions, please contact {email}.

Best regards,
{company}
recruitmentEmails.rejectionBody:
Dear {name},

Thank you for your interest in the {title} position at {company}. After careful review, we regret that we will not move forward with your application this time.

{message}To view or request erasure of your application data, please email {email}.

Best regards,
{company}
recruitmentEmails.interviewerBody:
Dear {name},

You are assigned to interview {candidate} ({round}, {title}).
Time: {time} ({duration} minutes)
{place}

Record your evaluation under My interviews in the HR mini app.
recruitmentEmails.interviewerCancelBody:
Dear {name},

The {round} with {candidate} ({title}) at {time} has been cancelled.

interviews.title: Interviews
interviews.sendCancellation: Email the cancellation (with calendar cancellation) to the candidate and interviewers
interviews.name: Round name
interviews.sendInvitation: Email the invitation (with .ics calendar file) to the candidate and interviewers
interviews.sendUpdate: Email the schedule change (with updated calendar file)
interviews.subject: Subject
interviews.mineHint: Interviews assigned to you. You only see the candidate information needed for the interview.
interviews.evaluationClosed: The application has ended: the evaluation can no longer be changed.
interviews.othersHidden: Other interviewers' evaluations appear after you submit yours.

offers.title: Job offers
offers.sendEmail: Email with a response link (untick if already communicated outside the system)
offers.sendHint: The response link is single use and expires after the deadline; resending invalidates the previous link.
offers.recordResponse: Record response on behalf of candidate
offers.outsideRangeHint: Required when the salary is outside the request's range; shown on the approval request.
offers.approvalHint: Submitted to the company's approval flow; the approval amount is the salary. Send the letter after approval.
offers.hireHint: Name, contacts, education, department, branch, job title and hire date are prefilled from the offer. Fill in the remaining required fields. The résumé is copied to the employee's documents.

reviews.notifyPublished: Review results for {cycle} have been published
reviews.title: Performance reviews
reviews.noTemplates: No review templates yet. Create a template before a cycle.
reviews.openHint: Opening the cycle creates a review for each active employee in scope with the department head as reviewer; template, weights and thresholds can no longer change.
reviews.closeHint: Close the cycle once every review is submitted by its reviewer or excluded.
reviews.gradesValue: A from {a} · B from {b} · C from {c} · D below {c}
reviews.unassigned: {count} reviews have no reviewer: choose one in the table.
reviews.draftHint: A draft cycle has no reviews: open it to create them.
reviews.distribution: Grade distribution: A {a} · B {b} · C {c} · D {d}
reviews.noScoring: No reviews are assigned to you.
reviews.adjustHint: Reviewer score: {score}. The adjusted score becomes official and needs a reason.
reviews.scaleHint: Scale 1–5: 1 Unsatisfactory · 2 Needs improvement · 3 Meets · 4 Good · 5 Outstanding. Submitting requires every row scored.
reviews.resultHidden: The reviewer has submitted. Results appear once HR publishes them.

hr.title: Employee records
hr.none: No records yet. Click "Add record" to start.
hr.codeHint: Leave blank to generate automatically. Enter the old code when migrating records.
hr.nationalityCode: Country code (2 letters, for example KR)
hr.hireHint: Saving creates a "Hired" decision in the work history.
hr.protectedHint: Leave blank to keep the stored value.
hr.encryptionNotice: Citizen ID, passport, bank account, tax code and social insurance numbers are encrypted at rest and shown masked.
hr.accountHint: Only active company members without a record are listed. Effective work decisions update the account's department, branch and job title.
hr.missingConsentWarning: The record has an ID image or health certificate but no consent to process sensitive data.
hr.minorWarning: Minor worker: written consent of the legal representative is required before signing a contract.
hr.file: PDF, JPG, PNG file (up to 10 MB)
hr.sensitiveUploadWarning: ID images and health certificates are sensitive personal data. Store copies only; do not keep the worker's originals.
hr.consentRecorded: Consent to process sensitive data recorded on {date}.
hr.newJobTitle: New job title (blank for no change)
hr.removeWorkEventText: Delete the decision dated {date} (not yet effective)?
hr.workEventHint: On the effective date, the linked account's department, branch and job title are updated. Roles do not change.
hr.meNotice: This is your personal data kept by the company. You can only view it; to change it, click "Request change".
hr.meNone: Your account is not linked to an employee record in this company.

contracts.title: Labour contracts
contracts.level_college: College or higher – up to 60 days
contracts.level_intermediate: Intermediate, technical worker, clerical staff – up to 30 days
contracts.level_other: Other work – up to 6 working days
contracts.probationHint: Probation pay must be at least 85% of the official salary.
contracts.legalExceptionHint: Labour Code Article 20.2: a fixed-term contract may be renewed only once, except where the law allows.
contracts.signedFile: Signed copy (PDF, JPG, PNG, up to 10 MB)
contracts.signHint: After approval, click "Confirm signed", enter the signing date and upload the signed copy.
contracts.appendixHint: An appendix cannot change the contract term (Labour Code Article 22.2). Leave unchanged items blank.
contracts.terminateEmployeeWarning: Signed contracts in effect end on the same date with the same reason; unsigned contracts are cancelled. The record becomes "Left" on that date. Company administrators are notified to disable the linked account.
contracts.expiringNone: No contracts expiring or expired without follow-up.
contracts.expiringHint: Signed probation and fixed-term contracts with 30 days or less left, or expired without a next contract. Over 30 days after expiry a fixed-term contract has become indefinite by law: create a new contract.
